title: Stop Saying "Said"! 3 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "said". Use one of these words instead:
• Whispered: "Be quiet," she whispered.
• Replied: "Yes, I can," he replied.
• Explained: "The bus was late," he explained.
